description: Update an organisation compensating control (write — editor). Only passed fields change; the control it is for does not. A changed risk_code is re-checked (409).

cc_id.description: Compensating control UUID — obtain from scf_list_org_compensating_controls

effectiveness_rating.description: Effectiveness: full, partial, minimal (cannot be cleared)

gap_description.description: What the control does not meet (cannot be cleared)

risk_code.description: Justifying accepted risk, re-checked as on create; null clears it, which a material control refuses

risk_reduction_notes.description: Risk reduction notes, or null to clear

name: scf_update_org_compensating_control
